history.message: Captured intent; renamed to feature branch feature/dashboard-hook-integration
Committed "add dashboard UI and UserPromptSubmit hook integration"

intent.intent: Add dashboard UI and UserPromptSubmit hook integration to enable in-process retrieval injection and visual pipeline monitoring.
intent.summary: Introduces a web dashboard for monitoring the retrieval pipeline and traces, a lightweight UserPromptSubmit hook shim to inject ranked file paths into Claude Code prompts, and feedback/trace modules to track retrieval quality by pairing injected files against what the agent actually opened. All new components are testable in isolation and thoroughly covered by added test cases.
intent.commitMessage: add dashboard UI and UserPromptSubmit hook integration

fileChanges.summary: Added Mermaid diagram documenting dashboard HTTP routes and API layer mapping.
Added Mermaid mindmap showing all CLI subcommands and their options.
Added template for recording debugging sessions and regressions.
Added diagram of language adapter architecture and gotchas.
Added architecture diagram showing daemon dispatch, retrieval stages, and index build.
Added diagram of test suite layout and fixture sharing.
Added retrieval manifest with keyword-to-diagram routing for memory augmentation.
Added project-scoped Claude Code settings with retrieval config and exclusions.
Added lightweight UserPromptSubmit hook: connects to daemon over unix socket, injects ranked file paths only (not contents), and fails open.
Added data layer for dashboard: endpoints for status, traces, sessions, config, and live pipeline probe with stage-by-stage breakdown.
Added HTTP server: routes GET/POST to api.py handlers, serves static files with path-escape validation.
Added single-page dashboard UI with hand-drawn aesthetic: views for vector DB stats, sessions, traces, config editor, and pipeline probe.
Added handwriting font for dashboard aesthetic (vendored, not generated).
Added OFL license for PatrickHand font.
Added implicit feedback tracking: reconciles traces against session history to compute used/wasted/extra files for retrieval quality metrics.
Added per-query trace recording and feedback schema: stores what each stage produced and what the gate decided.
Added daemon protocol tests: ping, cold-start indexing, shim injection, failure modes, socket locking, and stdlib-only verification.
Added feedback logic tests: trace-session matching, set arithmetic on injected/used/wasted/extra, grouping, and dashboard endpoint pagination.
Updated lock file: added numpy as a core dependency and fixed CUDA platform markers for consistency.

intent.riskReason: Adds new database schema (feedback table), HTTP endpoints, and hook infrastructure; all well-isolated from core retrieval logic but requires database migration and careful socket/server lifecycle testing.
testScenarios: Hook shim connects to daemon over unix socket and injects ranked file paths (not full contents) under 2KB
Hook shim fails open (returns exit 0, no output) when daemon is unreachable, input is empty, or repo is invalid
Hook shim uses only Python standard library to minimize import latency on every prompt
Dashboard loads and displays vector DB stats, file count by language, embedder model, and reranker metrics
Sessions endpoint reconciles traces against real session history and correctly computes precision, hit rate, and extra files
Feedback matching pairs traces with session turns on session_id+prompt (exact) or prompt+time window (fallback)
Paging the sessions list slices only the session rows; totals remain constant across pages
Pipeline probe endpoint runs a real retrieve request and returns stage-by-stage timing and decision breakdown
Config endpoint reads and writes settings to repo or global scope without corrupting existing values
Trace recording never raises (uses try/except) even if database is corrupted or disk full
